events.summary: Monthly-table integration exposed two bounded defects
events.detail: The listing parser initially rejected stress period 329 because it did not accept a trailing decimal, and the first UI validation caught an unused type import; both were corrected and retained in the event history.

events.summary: Monthly groundwater table and visible budget chart validated
events.detail: 361 monthly budget rows and 33 simulated-equivalent series are receipt-backed; Water at year 2000 displayed the selected month and head slice; 19 tests, registry validation, strict typing, production build, and live browser error/warning checks pass.

events.summary: Building immutable offline historical pack receipt
events.detail: Hashing every browser historical artifact, adding runtime pack validation, and exposing the pack status in the Record scene without adding network dependencies.

events.summary: Immutable historical-water pack is visible and verified
events.detail: Five local artifacts totaling 1143499 bytes have build-time SHA-256 and byte receipts; 21 tests and every registry, build, dist, release, direct-entry, and live-browser gate pass. Record scene displays the inventory with no runtime network dependency; browser errors and warnings are empty.

events.summary: Legacy USGS groundwater-level endpoint has moved
events.detail: The bounded 1986-2015 groundwater-level request returned a 301 HTML migration notice, not data. The response was kept only in temporary storage and is excluded from the project; migrating the adapter to api.waterdata.usgs.gov.

events.summary: Acquiring bounded USGS measured groundwater history
events.detail: Using the current official field-measurements OGC endpoint for parameter 72019 inside the published TVGWFM footprint and 1986-2015 baseline dates; raw pages are preserved on T drive with SHA-256 receipts and strict spatial, temporal, and parameter validation.

events.summary: Building explicit measured-groundwater comparison
events.detail: Aggregating the verified irregular parameter-72019 field readings by year, retaining counts, site counts, approval totals, depth quantiles, source hashes, and a no-datum-match boundary; the overlay will appear only under the explicit Compare action.

events.summary: Measured groundwater pack found provider null values
events.detail: The first aggregation attempt correctly failed instead of coercing missing readings: some USGS field-measurement records have null numeric values. Updating the contract to preserve source record count and report excluded-null count separately.

events.summary: Measured overlay type contract failed the first compile
events.detail: The initial patch placed source-wide count fields on annual rows and typed the mixed SVG/HTML node list too narrowly. Correcting the interfaces rather than weakening strict TypeScript.

events.summary: Live browser caught stale immutable-pack manifest
events.detail: After the six-artifact build passed, the browser reused cached v1 manifest bytes and the v2 loader failed closed. Preserving v1 and publishing the changed pack under a new v2 filename and identity.

events.summary: Observed groundwater Compare overlay passes clean browser gate
events.detail: Fresh cache-busted tab loaded immutable pack v2, Water year 2000, modeled budget chart, and observed depth distribution with explicit no-datum-match boundary. 23 tests, source-page hashes, missingness totals, registries, strict typing, build, dist, release, and browser error/warning checks pass.

events.summary: Acquiring well elevation and datum metadata
events.detail: Querying current USGS monitoring-locations in bounded batches of 100 for the 3168 measured sites; preserving original GeoJSON pages and validating returned IDs, elevations, datums, spatial bounds, byte counts, and SHA-256.

events.summary: All measured-well elevation and datum metadata verified
events.detail: USGS returned 3168 of 3168 requested locations in 32 original pages totaling 6905294 bytes. All page hashes and counts pass; every site has altitude; 2920 NAVD88 records are eligible for the next matching stage and 248 NGVD29 records remain explicitly excluded pending transformation.

events.summary: Mapping measured wells into the TVGWFM grid
events.detail: Building a compact point pack from verified USGS pages using the published model corners. NAVD88 altitude minus measured depth will be retained as observed water-level altitude; layer assignment and residual validation remain blocked without screen evidence.

events.summary: Spatial join verified; compact binary packaging next
events.detail: The join mapped 2849 NAVD88 sites covering 19117 numeric readings; excluded 241 non-NAVD88 sites, 63 sites without numeric readings, 13 inactive cells, and 2 outside-grid sites. The first columnar JSON was 337912 bytes and was moved to trash rather than shipped; converting it to a smaller typed binary before runtime integration.

events.summary: Encoding mapped groundwater wells for the 3D scene
events.detail: Replacing the 337912-byte prototype JSON with an interleaved float32 point pack containing longitude, latitude, and latest NAVD88 water-level altitude; adding structural tests and a bounded Three.js Points layer visible only in Water Compare mode.

events.summary: Mapped observed groundwater markers are live
events.detail: A fresh v3 browser tab loaded 2849 NAVD88 markers from a 34188-byte interleaved float32 pack. Water year 2000 Compare exposes the marker count and observed distribution; browser errors and warnings are empty. Twenty-four tests plus registry, build, dist, release, and direct-entry gates pass.
